A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the only essential uridine-derived nucleotide in tRNA is uridine.
the only uridine-derived minor base essential for the function of this tRNA in protein synthesis is uridine-5- oxyacetic acid.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of pseudouridine in tRNA is a necessary condition for the efficient binding of tRNA to ribosomes in vitro, but that this requirement is met by the presence of other uridine-derived nucleosides, including ribothymidine.
